candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored oracle address.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function oracle() public view returns (IOracleProvider) { return IOracleProvider(address(0)); }

candidates.change_summary: Replace the stored payoff definition read with a return of a zeroed default PayoffDefinition, so callers receive all-zero fields instead of the stored value.
Return the oracle's raw current version without applying the payoff-definition price transform, so the returned price differs whenever the payoff transform is non-identity.
